serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Nun.Face.nunFaceNormal(instant)
#Nun.animate(TransparencyTo1,1)
Is this…{{wi}} a nun? 
You: I thought you were supposed to be alone at this place? 
Was he… hiding this girl from me? Am I that creepy or something?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Just ignore this female. She’s no one important.
#Nun.Face.nunFaceAngry
Nun: That’s just plain rude! Why do you have to be like that? What’s wrong with you Priestcan?!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Alright, alright. Stop throwing a fit in church. I will allow you to introduce yourself. 
#Nun.Face.nunFaceNormal
Nun: Wow! How nice of you!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I’m merciful, even towards heathens. As by my Lord’s command.
#Nun.Face.nunFaceAngry
Nun: I was sarcastic you idiot!
I don’t know what’s going on, but this dark skin beauty is not in the best relationship with Mr Priest! Should I intervene? 
You: P-please, could you stop arguing?
Nun: Hell no! Who do you think you are? Never seen you here before. Actually, I never saw anyone here except this holy vending machine.
#Priestbot.Face.botFaceAngry(instant)
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I told you this already. Language like that is not befitting in a home of God. 
Wha?! What is this! Expression on Mr Priest changed!
Nun: Oh! So it’s alright to insult me, but if you are insulted it’s the end of the world. Ok Hypocrite Bot! 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: That’s false. {{wi}}Book of Revelation says that The End of the world will come when…
Nun: I didn’t mean literally! Geez! 
Their conversation got pretty heated up. I just want to leave already. 
Maybe if I slowly back off to the exit… {{wi}}they will fail to notice and I will be able to get out of here...
#Nun.animate(LeaveScreenToLeft,0.5)
#Priestbot.animate(LeaveScreenToLeft,0.5)
Alright… Step by step.
Oh no! She turned towards me!
